blockedIdentities.reason: Four Star is a generic name shared by unrelated businesses. The queue record has no product or corporate discriminator that can establish one manufacturer-owned source safely.
Franke is used by multiple industrial groups and specialist manufacturers. The raw identity does not distinguish the intended entity or product scope with sufficient certainty.
No accessible manufacturer-owned source was found that establishes Friand Elektrotechniek B.V. as a current manufacturer and documents a specific product range.

The official FRICKE Group source identifies an agricultural-machinery, commercial-vehicle and replacement-parts trading group. It does not establish the queue identity as one distinct manufacturer brand with a defensible product scope.

Romaco is the plausible current corporate owner, but the accessible current official pages did not provide a brand-specific FrymaKoruma identity and product page sufficient for publication under the strict gate.
FUBAG-branded commercial sites expose products but do not clearly establish a manufacturer-owned corporate identity or legal manufacturing entity suitable for Tier A verification.
Galvi is a short generic name used in unrelated industrial and materials contexts. No queue-level discriminator resolves the intended manufacturer-owned identity.

The official source resolves this record to Moog GAT GmbH, which is already represented by the existing canonical manufacturer identity 'moog'. Publishing both identities would create duplicate manufacturer pages for the same current company.

The Gamar record shares the Sacemi-Gamar domain, company lineage and pump/motor scope with the canonical sacemi-gamar identity. Current first-party evidence does not justify a second standalone indexable manufacturer profile.
